about: What a deletion-only repair actually reaches, measured per damage class. This replaces the Fault Atlas field repair.reachable_by_deletion, which the migration of 2026-09-09 wrote from the damage class by a lookup table and never measured.
repairer: pgrepair, SciPyWeightedILP, workloads eurlex-labels.toml then eurlex-laws.toml, --mark --disable-cache

WRONG_LABEL.verdict: yes, and it costs 12,591 true facts: the repair deletes the nodes, not their labels

SPLIT.verdict: no; 24 twins of 1,355 were deleted and 1,674 true facts they took were not restored

contradicts_the_atlas.note: 0 of 5,276 reached on three identical runs

contradicts_the_atlas.measured: yes only when a law can see it
contradicts_the_atlas.note: 360 of 360 visible, 6 of 361 invisible. A flat yes erases the distinction the bench exists to make

reserve: The measurement is per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer, and the atlas says so rather than claiming 162 measured forms.
